correctness.rationale: Verified the full finite-projective-plane incidence identity BB^T=B^TB=sI+J and reversibility of transfer T=(A −I;I 0). If s≡2 mod3, v≡1 and A vanishes on two constant shore vectors, A²=−I on the 2(v−1) complement, yielding T²=−I on its four-dimensional time lift and T⁴=−I on the other; global order8 and E(t)=4·1_(4|t)+4(v−1)·1_(8|t). If s≡1, v≡0 and J²=0 while B is invertible; each spatial sign ±1 has one Jordan size2 and v−2 size1. The temporal quadratic x²−λx+1=(x+λ)² and one-dimensional temporal eigenspaces lift these to one size4 and v−2 size2 blocks per sign, giving order18 and E(t)=(1+1_(2|t))[min(4,3^nu3(t))+(v−2)min(2,3^nu3(t))]. Finite-field fixed-space formula plus Möbius inversion yields all primitive populations. Independently constructed finite incidence matrices for plane orders2 and4 and checked exact mod3 nullities: order2 t=1,4,8 -> (0,4,28); order4 t=1,2,3,6,9,18 -> (20,40,41,82,42,84). General proof is algebraic for every plane, not an extrapolation from these checks.

value.rationale: A complete temporal-orbit classification for an entire natural family of incidence graphs, all projective planes (including non-Desarguesian ones) of two nonresonant congruence classes, and all F3 extensions. It exposes a sharp order-mod-three bifurcation (8 versus18) and exact orbit populations, which distinguish algebraic dynamics beyond generic reversibility.

limitations: Orders divisible by3 require potentially additional incidence rank data.
Finite tests do not prove the all-plane formula; proof uses modular linear algebra.
